description: Closes the highest-value named-product leads from SOR/2007-303 (Equalization and Territorial Formula Financing). Nodes and edges are limited to products explicitly named in the regulation and matched to live Statistics Canada programmes or tables. DIVISION 1 vs DIVISION 2 (Nova Scotia) scope is recorded on every edge. Commercial-source rule applied to R.L. Polk.

reports.name: Provincial and Territorial Economic Accounts (Provincial and Territorial GDP by Income and by Expenditure Accounts)
reports.notes: Primary product named in DIVISION 1 definitions of household final consumption expenditures, residential renovations, and residential housing transfers.

reports.name: Provincial Supply and Use Tables (detail under Supply, Use and Input-Output Tables)
reports.notes: Names specific matrices (summary level final demand matrix and intermediate input matrix) in DIVISION 1. Also used for GDP at factor cost in DIVISION 2.

reports.name: Canadian Government Finance Statistics
reports.notes: Named in both DIVISION 1 and Territorial Formula Financing sections for fiscal capacity measures.

reports.name: Annual Oil and Gas Extraction Survey (OGEX)
reports.notes: Named in DIVISION 2 for oil and gas volume and value bases. Directly relevant to the existing Alberta energy-royalty cluster.

reports.name: Sales of fuel used for road motor vehicles, annual
reports.notes: Modern table number already used in the general Interpretation section of SOR/2007-303 (s. 1(1)).

reports.name: Value of sales of alcoholic beverages of liquor authorities and other retail outlets, by beverage type
reports.notes: Live table is the direct successor of the CANSIM number still cited in DIVISION 2. TFF uses the modern number.

reports.name: Balance sheet of the agricultural sector as at December 31st
reports.notes: DIVISION 2 only. TFF measures the same conceptual farm value from the Census of Agriculture instead.

reports.name: Vehicle Registrations (legacy CANSIM 405-0004 / Survey 2747)
reports.notes: DIVISION 2 only. Regulation contains an explicit Ministerial fallback if Statistics Canada ceases to produce the determination.

reports.name: R.L. Polk & Co. publication Canadian and International Registration Manual
reports.publisher: R.L. Polk & Co. (later World Data Corp / Polk)
reports.notes: Commercial-source rule. Named verbatim in SOR/2007-303 s. 8(1)(i) for weighted average licence fees. Third commercial product found inside a Canadian federal funding formula.

dependencies.basis: SOR/2007-303 s. 3.1 (DIVISION 1): household final consumption expenditures, residential renovations, and residential housing transfers 'as determined by Statistics Canada for the purpose of its Provincial and Territorial Economic Accounts'

SOR/2007-303 s. 3.1 (DIVISION 1): capital and intermediate input expenditures from the Provincial Supply and Use Tables’ summary level final demand matrix and intermediate input matrix; also s. 8(1)(z) (DIVISION 2) for GDP at factor cost
SOR/2007-303 s. 5(b)(ii) (DIVISION 1) and s. 19(1)(b)(ii) (TFF): data prepared by Statistics Canada for the purpose of the Government Finance Statistics
SOR/2007-303 s. 8(1)(p) and parallel oil/gas provisions (DIVISION 2): volume and value 'as determined by Statistics Canada on the basis of its survey Oil and Gas Extraction'
SOR/2007-303 s. 1(1) (general Interpretation): fuel quantities 'as determined by Statistics Canada for the purpose of table 23-10-0066-01'
SOR/2007-303 s. 19(1)(f) (TFF) uses modern table 10-10-0011-01; DIVISION 2 s. 8(1)(j) still cites predecessor CANSIM 183-0024
SOR/2007-303 s. 8(1)(z) (DIVISION 2): farm land value from CANSIM table 002-0020 (now 32-10-0056-01)
SOR/2007-303 s. 8(1)(h) and (i) (DIVISION 2): registrations from CANSIM table 405-0004 (current Vehicle Registrations programme, Survey 2747). Regulation includes Ministerial fallback.
SOR/2007-303 s. 8(1)(i) (DIVISION 2): weighted average licence fees calculated from data in the R.L. Polk & Co. publication Canadian and International Registration Manual

notes: All edges are strictly limited to products named in SOR/2007-303. No inference or soft methodology edges.
DIVISION 2 (Nova Scotia) retains several CANSIM-era citations that have modern successors; succession is recorded but not treated as a new statutory edge.
R.L. Polk is admitted under the commercial-source rule already used for J.D. Power and ICE Brent.
This slice closes the highest-value leads identified in equalization-named-products.json. Remaining lower-priority or ambiguous leads stay in the original file.
